_note: ALL questions are verified:false. The team must check each one on-site before launch. 'note' is for the team only and is never shown to players. Options are shuffled in the game, so the answer index here can be anything.

questions.text: Which Lockwood floor is meant for quiet study?
questions.explain: The 4th floor study area is designed for focused, distraction-free work.
questions.note: From UI-PLAN example. Check the floor on-site.

questions.text: Who is Lockwood Library named after?
questions.explain: It is named for Thomas B. Lockwood, a Buffalo lawyer whose gift helped build UB's library.

questions.text: Lockwood is UB's main library for which subjects?
questions.explain: Lockwood holds UB's main collections for the humanities and social sciences.

questions.text: Capen Hall is named after Samuel P. Capen. Who was he?
questions.explain: Samuel P. Capen led UB as chancellor from 1922 to 1950.

questions.text: Which library is inside Capen Hall?
questions.explain: The Oscar A. Silverman Library is inside Capen Hall.

questions.text: What can students get help with at 1Capen?
questions.explain: 1Capen is a one-stop help center for student services like registration, billing and financial aid.

questions.text: Which department calls Davis Hall home?
questions.explain: Davis Hall is home to UB's Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

questions.text: Davis Hall is part of which UB school?
options: School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
questions.explain: Davis Hall belongs to the School of Engineering and Applied Sciences.

questions.text: About when did Davis Hall open?
questions.explain: Davis Hall is one of the newer buildings on North Campus. It opened in the 2010s.

questions.text: Which student group has its offices in the Student Union and funds many clubs?
questions.explain: The Student Association runs from the Student Union and supports many student clubs.

questions.text: What is the Student Union best known for?
questions.explain: The Student Union is the main spot on North Campus for food, clubs and events.

questions.text: Which campus is this Student Union on?
questions.explain: This Student Union is on UB's North Campus in Amherst.

questions.text: What happens in the Center for the Arts besides classes?
questions.explain: The CFA has theaters and galleries, so it hosts live shows and art exhibits.

questions.text: Which of these is taught in the Center for the Arts?
questions.explain: Theatre and dance classes and rehearsals take place in the CFA.

questions.text: About when did the Center for the Arts open?
questions.explain: The Center for the Arts opened in the 1990s.

questions.text: What is the name of UB's mascot?
questions.explain: Victor E. Bull is the UB Bulls mascot. You will see him at games here.

questions.text: Which UB teams play home games in Alumni Arena?
questions.explain: Alumni Arena is home court for UB Bulls basketball.

questions.text: About when did Alumni Arena open?
questions.explain: Alumni Arena opened in the 1980s.
questions.note: Believed to be 1982. Also check the team plan's name 'Broadview Arena'.

questions.text: What does NSC stand for?
questions.explain: NSC is short for Natural Sciences Complex.

questions.text: Which subjects are mainly taught in the NSC?
questions.explain: The NSC is home to chemistry and biological sciences.
questions.note: Check which departments are in NSC.

questions.text: What kind of rooms will you find a lot of in the NSC?
questions.explain: The NSC is packed with teaching and research labs.

questions.text: Clemens Hall is named after Samuel Clemens. What is his famous pen name?
questions.explain: Samuel Clemens wrote as Mark Twain, and he once lived in Buffalo.

questions.text: What did Mark Twain do while he lived in Buffalo?
questions.explain: He was part owner and an editor of the Buffalo Express newspaper around 1869 to 1871.

questions.text: Which department is based in Clemens Hall?
questions.explain: Clemens Hall is home to UB's English department.
